explicit_limitations: The PHK2 RTL identifies USER3 through JTAG_CHAIN=3 but does not contain the numeric opcode; the opcode here is derived from the local vendor simulation model and still needs qualification-owner approval.
The exact TAP state before the reset prefix is not established; transition rows for those reset clocks are therefore not exact.
The existing PHK2 BSCANE2 simulation stub ties all primitive outputs low and is not an event-level TAP/BSCAN model.
The 32-bit status response is a runtime snapshot relationship, not a fixed constant. No numeric expected TDO response is asserted.
This candidate is not the matrix-approved method, is not physically qualified, and is not executable. IDCODE-only evidence remains insufficient for the BSCAN interaction case.
